title: Stochastic Decision Horizons for Survival-Based Constrained Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.04599v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose stochastic decision horizons (SDH), a theoretically grounded framework for survival-based constrained reinforcement learning from per-step violation signals. Rather than treating violations as expenditure of a cumulative budget, SDH shortens the effective decision horizon when violations occur, reducing current reward credit and future bootstrapping. We show that this construction represents a geometric-horizon survival constraint and, for a fixed Lagrange multiplier, remains the same SDH problem up to a constant reward offset that acts as an implicit incentive for survival. Using control as inference, we derive two off-policy and replay-compatible, regularized algorithms with post-violation semantics. Absorbing-state ends the decision process, so only surviving decisions pay policy KL, yielding AS-SAC. Virtual termination stops reward credit while the process continues, retaining ordinary discounted KL and yielding VT-MPO

translated_title: 面向基于生存的约束强化学习的随机决策视界
translated_abstract: 我们提出了随机决策视界（SDH），这是一个理论基础扎实的框架，用于从每步违规信号出发实现基于生存的约束强化学习。SDH 不将违规视为对累积预算的消耗，而是在违规发生时缩短有效决策视界，从而减少当前的奖励信用和未来的自举（bootstrapping）。我们证明这一构造代表了一种几何视界生存约束，并且对于固定的拉格朗日乘子，在恒定奖励偏移的意义上它仍是同一个 SDH 问题，该偏移充当一种隐式的生存激励。利用“控制即推断”（control as inference）的方法，我们推导出两种离策略、与经验回放兼容且具有违规后语义的正则化算法。吸收态方法终止决策过程，因此只有存活的决策才需承担策略 KL 散度代价，由此得到 AS-SAC；虚拟终止方法在决策过程继续的同时停止奖励信用，保留普通的折扣 KL，由此得到 VT-MPO。
tldr: 提出随机决策视界（SDH）框架，通过在违规发生时缩短有效决策视界（而非消耗累积预算）来实现基于生存的约束强化学习，并据此推导出 AS-SAC 和 VT-MPO 两种离策略正则化算法。
en_tdlr: Proposes stochastic decision horizons (SDH), a theoretically grounded framework for survival-based constrained RL that shortens the effective decision horizon upon violations rather than depleting a cumulative budget, yielding two off-policy regularized algorithms, AS-SAC and VT-MPO.
